notes: Added API surface, integration hook, and negative testing coverage to complete enforcement lifecycle.

stories.title: Expose Enforced GPTReader API Endpoint Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the Azure Function HTTP interface for GPTReader requests, ensuring all incoming payloads are routed through the scope enforcement pipeline before any data access.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into GPTReader Execution Path
stories.description: Wire allowlist validation, sanitization, and error handling into the GPTReader execution flow so that no query reaches MongoDB without passing enforcement checks.

stories.title: Implement Negative Unit Tests for Allowlist Violations
stories.description: Create unit tests covering unauthorized collections, invalid fields, disallowed operators, and limit violations to ensure enforcement blocks all invalid access attempts.

stories.title: Add Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
stories.description: Extend GPTReader audit logging to capture allowlist enforcement outcomes (pass/fail, rule triggered) without exposing sensitive query details.
